paper.title: Early cessation of pressure garment therapy results in scar contraction and thickening

withdrawal_geometry.model: female Red Duroc pig full-thickness burn wounds with split-thickness autograft
observed_recurrence: collagen orientation/thickness changes toward untreated-scar phenotype

why_H1_is_supported: Mechanical benefit is present under compression and substantially regresses after the mechanical intervention is removed.

strict_delayed_root_relation.reason: Compression began within the first week after injury, before an established mature scar state. This root therefore cannot replace the delayed day-28 Kim strict skin root and cannot establish post-lock rewrite.

claim_ceiling.supported: Long mechanical improvement can remain intervention-dependent and can regress rapidly after withdrawal.
